opportunities.name: Hotel search, currency conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a destination for given dates, convert the price from EUR to a target currency on xe.com, then draft an email to a contact proposing the hotel.
steps: On Booking enter destination and select check-in/check-out dates, then Search
Open the chosen hotel and note name and price in EUR
On xe.com Currency Converter enter the EUR amount and select the target currency, click Convert
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>'
Write body with hotel name, EUR price, converted amount, and 'OK to book?'

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-20, Vienna House 818 EUR to USD, maria
Milan, Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti 264 EUR to JPY, kenji
Amsterdam, Jan 12-15 2027, Jan Luyken 577 EUR to GBP, aisha

opportunities.name: City weather and news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day weather forecast, search BBC news for '<city> strike', then email a contact a heads-up with the forecast and top headline.
steps: On the weather site search for the city and open the 10 Day forecast
Note the day's high/low and conditions
On BBC search '<city> strike' and open the top article for headline and date
Compose email to recipient with subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'
Write body with forecast and headline

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up a Wikipedia 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' page, find the entry for a destination country, check that country's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens'
Find destination country's visa status and allowed stay
On timeanddate open Holidays and select the destination country
Read holidays for the relevant month
Add a note summarizing visa and holidays
